gridConvention: Vertices inclusive of bounds; row-major north to south, columns west to east. Elevations in metres NZVD2016. Source 1m DEM bilinearly sampled at 10m intervals.
attribution: Copyright in the underlying elevation dataset from which this work has been derived is owned by Horizons Regional Council. Aerial imagery © Manawatū-Whanganui LASS. Both distributed by Toitū Te Whenua LINZ under CC BY 4.0.
sourceDescription: Horizons Regional Council / LINZ, Manawatū–Whanganui LiDAR surveyed 2015–2016. The 1 m ground model is sampled at 10 m spacing for this interactive view. Elevations are metres NZVD2016.
aerialDescription: Manawatū–Whanganui LASS rural aerial photographs, flying seasons 2021–2022, distributed by LINZ. Original 30 cm imagery is sampled at 1 m per pixel for this model.
